update_log: Exhaustive compilation of famous books and authors spanning Ancient India, the Freedom Struggle, contemporary award-winners, and international classics for Static GK.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Chanakya (Kautilya)
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: An ancient Indian treatise on statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Panini
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: The foundational text of Sanskrit grammar and linguistics.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Kalidasa
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: Masterpieces of Sanskrit poetry and drama from the Gupta period.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Vishnu Sharma
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: An ancient Indian collection of interrelated animal fables.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Banabhatta
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: Banabhatta was the court poet of King Harsha; 'Harshacharita' is the biography of the king.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Kalhana
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: A historical chronicle of the kings of Kashmir; one of the earliest Indian historical texts.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Vishakhadatta
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: A Sanskrit play narrating the ascent of king Chandragupta Maurya to power.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Abul Fazl
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: Detailed documents recording the administration and history of Mughal Emperor Akbar's empire.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Babur
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: The autobiography of the first Mughal Emperor, written in the Chagatai Turkic language.

ancient_and_medieval_literature.author: Tulsidas
ancient_and_medieval_literature.significance: An epic poem in the Awadhi language, retelling the Ramayana.

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.book: The Discovery of India & Glimpses of World History
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: Jawaharlal Nehru
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: Written during Nehru's imprisonment at Ahmednagar Fort (1942–1946).

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.book: The Story of My Experiments with Truth & Hind Swaraj
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: Mahatma Gandhi
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: Gandhi's autobiography and his seminal tract on Indian home rule.

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: An autobiographical account from one of the chief architects of Indian independence.

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: Set in the background of the Sannyasi Rebellion; contains the national song 'Vande Mataram'.

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: Rabindranath Tagore
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: A collection of poems that won Tagore the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1913.

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: B.R. Ambedkar
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: An undelivered speech and seminal text criticizing the Hindu caste system.

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.book: Poverty and Un-British Rule in India
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: Dadabhai Naoroji
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: Formulated the 'Wealth Drain Theory', exposing the economic exploitation of India by the British.

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: Bal Gangadhar Tilak
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: Written in Mandalay prison; presents a detailed analysis of Karma Yoga in the Bhagavad Gita.

freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.author: Lala Lajpat Rai
freedom_struggle_and_modern_india.significance: Written as a strong rebuttal to Katherine Mayo's highly biased book 'Mother India'.

contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.author: Salman Rushdie
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.significance: Winner of the Booker Prize (1981) and the 'Booker of Bookers' (1993).

contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.author: Aravind Adiga
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.significance: Winner of the Booker Prize (2008); a dark comedy about India's class struggle.

contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.author: Geetanjali Shree
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.significance: Winner of the International Booker Prize (2022); the first Hindi novel to win the award.

contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.author: Vikram Seth
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.significance: One of the longest novels ever published in a single volume in the English language.

contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.book: An Era of Darkness: The British Empire in India
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.author: Shashi Tharoor
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.significance: Won the Sahitya Akademi Award; details the destructive impact of British colonial rule.

contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.author: Jhumpa Lahiri
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.significance: Explores the immigrant experience and clashes of culture; Lahiri also won the Pulitzer for 'Interpreter of Maladies'.

contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.author: Amitav Ghosh
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.significance: Sahitya Akademi Award-winning novel focusing on the impact of historical events on individual lives.

contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.author: Sachin Tendulkar (Co-authored with Boria Majumdar)
contemporary_indian_and_award_winners.significance: The official autobiography of the cricket legend.

international_classics_and_autobiographi.author: George Orwell
international_classics_and_autobiographi.significance: Dystopian classics warning against totalitarianism, mass surveillance, and Stalinism.

international_classics_and_autobiographi.author: Nelson Mandela
international_classics_and_autobiographi.significance: The autobiography detailing Mandela's early life, coming of age, education, and 27 years in prison.

international_classics_and_autobiographi.author: Stephen Hawking
international_classics_and_autobiographi.significance: A landmark volume in science writing that explores cosmology, black holes, and the Big Bang.

international_classics_and_autobiographi.author: Harper Lee
international_classics_and_autobiographi.significance: Pulitzer Prize-winning novel dealing with serious issues of racial inequality and rape in the American South.

international_classics_and_autobiographi.book: The Diary of a Young Girl
international_classics_and_autobiographi.author: Anne Frank
international_classics_and_autobiographi.significance: A diary kept by a Jewish teenager while in hiding with her family during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands.

international_classics_and_autobiographi.author: Karl Marx
international_classics_and_autobiographi.significance: A foundational theoretical text in materialist philosophy, economics, and politics.

international_classics_and_autobiographi.author: Adam Smith
international_classics_and_autobiographi.significance: Published in 1776; the foundational text of classical free-market economic theory.

international_classics_and_autobiographi.author: Charles Darwin
international_classics_and_autobiographi.significance: Introduced the scientific theory that populations evolve over the course of generations through a process of natural selection.
